description: The line plot compares the loss evolution of the vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM model over training time, with training time in seconds on the x-axis ranging from 0 to 250,000 and loss on the y-axis ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. The vanilla model is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and gradually decreasing to a final loss of about 2.50 at 250,000 seconds. The SepLLM model is shown as a red line with circular markers, beginning at a similar loss of around 2.75 and decreasing more rapidly to a final loss of approximately 2.45 at the same training time. A green dashed horizontal line at a loss of 2.50 indicates the point at which both models reach this threshold, with the SepLLM model achieving it at approximately 200,000 seconds, while the vanilla model reaches it later. The green annotation highlights that SepLLM reaches a loss of 2.50 approximately 1.26 times faster than the vanilla model, as indicated by the ratio of the training times at that loss level. Overall, SepLLM demonstrates both faster convergence and lower final loss compared to the vanilla model.
caption_used: The line plot compares the loss between the vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM model over training time. SepLLM demonstrates a consistently lower loss across all training durations, achieving a final loss of approximately 2.45 at 250,000 seconds, compared to the vanilla model's final loss of 2.50. Additionally, SepLLM exhibits a faster convergence rate, reaching a loss of 2.50 nearly 1.5× faster than the vanilla model, as indicated by the green annotations.
